name: Fabio Valentina's Models
safety_reasons: Exit condition #0 (concept:support (bullish)) is IDENTICAL to a condition already required in entry_conditions (concept:support (bullish)). That clause is guaranteed true the moment a position opens, so the exit gate can be satisfied again almost immediately -- the exact defect found in Liquidity Sweep & FVG Validation Strategy (93.9% of trades closed within 1 bar, account ground to zero by commission/slippage).

Exit condition #1 (concept:resistance (bearish)) is IDENTICAL to a condition already required in entry_conditions (concept:resistance (bearish)). That clause is guaranteed true the moment a position opens, so the exit gate can be satisfied again almost immediately -- the exact defect found in Liquidity Sweep & FVG Validation Strategy (93.9% of trades closed within 1 bar, account ground to zero by commission/slippage).

Every exit condition relies only on slow-moving price-level concepts (resistance, support), which typically stay true for many consecutive bars once satisfied. An exit gate built entirely from these gives a trade little to no realistic room to travel toward its stop-loss or take-profit before closing itself out.
